name: io.github.nodesaint/mcp-applemusic
title: Apple Music
description: Give Claude control of Apple Music on macOS: search your library, build playlists, run playback. Persistent-ID based, injection-safe, syncs to iPhone.

environmentVariables.name: MUSIC_MCP_READONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to run read-only: every state-changing tool (playback, create/add/remove/rename/delete playlist, rate) is disabled; search and browse still work.
